properties.name: --ae-anchor-origin-x

properties.name: --ae-anchor-switch-duration
properties.description:
Native target-switch transition duration; reduced motion disables the transition.

Value syntax: <time>.

Default behavior: "0ms".

Suggested values: `0ms`, `150ms`, `250ms`. This is an open grammar, not a closed enumeration.

properties.name: --ae-anchor-switch-ease
properties.description:
Easing for native Anchor target switches.

Value syntax: <easing-function>.

Default behavior: "ease-in-out".

Suggested values: `linear`, `ease`, `ease-in-out`. This is an open grammar, not a closed enumeration.
